title: Create a temporary private SSM tunnel host for EKS administration
classification_reason: enables a private administrative network path
expected_outcome: A single private, no-inbound EC2 instance can be reached only with AWS Systems Manager and used as an SSM TCP tunnel to the private EKS endpoint; it is automatically terminated at 22:00 KST on 2026-09-04.
constraints: Use only the approved node-operator VPC private subnet and no public IP or inbound security-group rule.
Use SSM Session Manager only; do not add SSH keys, an Internet gateway, NAT, or a public endpoint.
Do not access Kubernetes resources, Secret data, Vault, Helm, CodeBuild, or application workloads in this task.
Use the host only as an SSM port-forward target; do not install or persist Kubernetes credentials or secret material on it.
Create a one-time automatic termination at 22:00 KST on 2026-09-04 and record only non-sensitive resource metadata and termination-schedule evidence.

external_actions: create exactly one private SSM-managed EC2 operations host in the approved node-operator VPC
create its least-privilege IAM instance role/profile, no-ingress security group, and one-time automatic termination schedule
read non-sensitive EC2, SSM, VPC, endpoint, and Terraform state metadata for verification

primary_owner.responsibility: network boundary, time-bounded access, live-plan gate, and integration

acceptance_checks: existing SSM reachability and AMI pattern
delegations.escalation_trigger: requires public network or Kubernetes credentials
evidence suggests an inbound/public/admin persistence boundary
